run_subtask_tests: run the absltest unit tests for SubTaskOption including arg_spec, pterm, and observable tests
test_stubsubtask_class: test the StubSubTask class to verify agent_to_parent_action and parent_to_agent_timestep delegation
test_subtaskoption_arg_spec: test that SubTaskOption delegates arg_spec to the underlying SubTask's arg_spec method
test_subtaskoption_pterm: test that SubTaskOption.pterm delegates to the SubTask's pterm method with the agent timestep
test_spy_subtask_observer: test the SpySubTaskObserver to verify it records parent and agent timesteps and actions per step
